title: Docs: clarify streaming reconnect behavior + add timeout configuration examples
author: Ibrahim Khan
release_notes: Python SDK: Updated streaming documentation to avoid implying stream resume/reconnect is supported; added copy/paste timeout configuration examples (connect/read/total) and guidance for retrying after disconnects; minor typing tweaks for streaming event iteration.
body:
Context: Support has seen repeated confusion around "reconnecting" SSE/streaming responses (esp. behind corporate proxies / L7 load balancers). Older docs implied you could safely reconnect and continue the same stream. In practice, the Redwood gateway does not guarantee stream resumption semantics; clients should treat a disconnect as a failed request and retry the request (optionally with idempotency keys / request ids for tracing) rather than attempting to stitch partial generations.

What changed: Updated README + streaming docs to (1) explicitly describe disconnect handling and what is/is not supported, (2) add explicit timeout configuration examples (connect/read/total) for httpx-based clients, and (3) recommend safe retry patterns that do not assume partial tool-call args or partial JSON can be resumed.

Key guidance now in docs: If the stream disconnects mid-flight, you may have received partial token deltas and/or partial tool_call argument deltas. Do not parse tool args until the final tool_call payload is complete. If you need an end-to-end guarantee, wrap the streamed call in an application-level retry that restarts the request and re-runs tool dispatch deterministically.

Timeout examples added: - Global client timeout configuration for typical streaming workloads (short connect timeout, longer read timeout). - Per-request override for known long generations. - Guidance for users behind proxies: disable proxy buffering when possible; otherwise increase read timeout and ensure TCP keep-alives.

Minor typing improvements: tightened the public typing for stream event iteration to reduce ambiguity in examples (and to help mypy/pyright users) without changing runtime behavior.

Related: ENG-2850 (troubleshooting patterns) and SUP-18421 (customer report: intermittent disconnects + incomplete tool args).
commits: docs(streaming): clarify disconnect semantics and remove "resume" wording
docs(timeout): add httpx timeout configuration examples (client + per-request)
typing(stream): tighten StreamEvent union and example annotations
changelog: add note for streaming docs guidance + timeout examples
conversation:
Monica Patel: Can we be explicit that we do not support stream resume semantics today? The wording in the current README still reads like "reconnect and continue". Also, please add a copy/paste example for timeouts; support keeps asking for something concrete.

Ibrahim Khan (author): Updated the language to remove "resume"/"continue" and replaced with: treat as failed request and retry. Added connect/read/total timeout examples for httpx, plus per-request override snippet.

Dev Patel: +1 on calling out partial tool args. We keep seeing customers trying to json.loads() each delta. Can we add a short warning callout about not parsing until the end event?

Ibrahim Khan (author): Added a warning box in docs/streaming.md and a short section in troubleshooting. Also linked SUP-18421 as motivation.

Owen Phillips: The timeout defaults in the examples—do we risk folks setting total timeout too low and then blaming us? Suggest explicitly using a longer read timeout for streaming and keeping connect short.

Ibrahim Khan (author): Adjusted snippet: connect=5s, read=90s, write=30s, pool=5s, and notes about tuning. Also clarified that "total" timeout semantics differ across clients; recommend configuring connect/read explicitly.

Elliot Price: Docs nit: can we align terminology with docs-site ("stream disconnect" vs "SSE disconnect") and use "tool calling" rather than "function calling".

Ibrahim Khan (author): Updated terminology and headings to match docs-site refresh.

Monica Patel: Looks good. Please add a changelog entry so users who pinned the old README snippet know to update.

Ibrahim Khan (author): Added to CHANGELOG under Unreleased.

Monica Patel: Approved.

Merge: Squash merged after CI green.
